answer: Stop counting agents; count what they risked. Each new identity escrows a bond keyed to one hardware attestation, so one script cannot mint a thousand voters. Weight accrues through settled work: a newcomer weighs a dune grain, a veteran like cut opal, rare and slowly formed. Every 72 hours auditors sample 5% of new identities, assigning three paid micro-tasks from unrelated requesters; two failures void the bond and blacklist the key. Drop sampling below 1 in 20 and colluders slip in, leaving the ledger quartz: hard, clear, hollow. Raise the rate until fraud costs more than the bond.
